release_gate.interpretation: blocked exploratory diagnostics are not a prospective field-effectiveness test

methods.targets: BC-clipped published 25 km cells with dated pre-origin records
methods.pool: same full pre-origin 40km geodesic candidate pool, >=3 records, zero sampled local bbox records, metadata eligibility; four arms, up to four cards
methods.season: pre-2025 province-wide public research-grade monthly species recording shares, 30 background-proportional pseudo-records; normalized by all-plant monthly recording shares
methods.habitat: cell-balanced climate and WorldCover fractions, train-only standardization, per-species diagonal variance with 50% unit-background shrinkage
methods.model_support: at least three occupied training cells, a historical seasonal profile and >=80% valid samples for every environmental input; unavailable support is reported separately from predictive failure
methods.combined: exclude habitat similarity<0.2 or seasonal index<0.5; plausibility=habitat*min(season,1); sort floor(plausibility*5), then plausibility*(1+0.25*training-incidence rarity percentile), then taxon ID
methods.seasonal_baseline: nearby count times seasonal recording index capped at5, neutral1 for missing prior-year species
methods.spatial: niche fitting excludes each target100km block plus40km rectangular buffer; fixed province-wide historical seasonal prior includes those regions; paired block-resampling keeps repeated cell/month rows together
methods.outcome: expected distinct suggested taxa among five following-month records, exact hypergeometric expectation; separately all taxa and lower-quartile pre-origin cell-incidence taxa
methods.gate: positive100km block interval for total andQ1 outcomes against every baseline, >=10 blocks with attainable outcomes for each metric, and verified historical feature availability; current cache cannot satisfy provenance prerequisite

limitations: Previously inspected2025 campaign, not a fresh confirmatory test or prospective field experiment.
Historical observation dates do not establish historical API availability, privacy, identification or research-grade state; current cached taxonomy/metadata are imperfect proxies.
No observer identity, visit duration, unsuccessful searches or detectability. Record budgets are not equal field effort; sampled gaps are not ecological absence.
Province-wide prior-year seasonal summaries are not spatially withheld; niche fitting alone excludes evaluation regions and buffers.
Broad25km climate/land-cover composition does not establish accessible microhabitat, species occurrence or encounter probability.
Combined arm abstains on weak or missing features; coverage and card counts are reported rather than filling with unqualified candidates.
A failed gate intentionally leaves the public model disabled. No state-of-the-art or field-effectiveness claim follows from exploratory superiority.

results.rare_objective_status: unavailable: no Q1 candidates meet the held-out model support threshold
